(NYSE: BLK) today reported financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. $15.5 trillion in AUM following $869 billion of net inflows over the last twelve months, representing 10% organic base fee growth $205 billion of net inflows and 11% annualized organic base fee growth in the quarter reflect broad-based strength across iShares ® ETFs, systematic active equities, private markets, and cash 19% increase in revenue year-over-year reflects the positive impact of markets, organic base fee growth, higher performance fees, and higher technology services and subscription revenue 14% growth in technology services and subscription revenue year-over-year , driven by continued momentum in Aladdin® and multi-product solutions 19% increase in year-over-year GAAP operating income and 25% increase in GAAP diluted EPS impacted by a noncash change in fair value of contingent consideration associated with prior acquisitions, which has been excluded from as adjusted results 27% increase in year-over-year as adjusted operating income 38% increase in year-over-year as adjusted diluted EPS also reflects higher nonoperating income in the current quarter $550 million of share repurchases in the current quarter Laurence D. Fink, Chairman and CEO: “BlackRock's results demonstrate the value of our integrated platform, as clients increasingly choose us as a partner across investing, financing, and technology. That client trust is translating into higher earnings power, with shareholders benefiting from a more than 35% increase in adjusted earnings per share year-over-year, a 47.8% adjusted operating margin, and 11% annualized organic base fee growth in the third quarter. “BlackRock brings together issuer relationships built over decades, financing expertise, investment performance, and the technology and data that connect it all. That combination is differentiating us in every region in which we operate. It’s why BlackRock is winning mandates at the cutting edge of capital markets, from hyperscaler financings to pension outsourcings to Aladdin and Preqin partnerships. “Clients entrusted us with $205 billion of net inflows this quarter, and $869 billion over the last year. Our results reflect the scale of BlackRock, with 12% technology ACV growth and net inflows across every asset class, client type, region, and across active and index. Our track record of strong investment performance drove $66 billion of active net inflows, led by our fixed income and systematic franchises. iShares generated $135 billion of net inflows, diversified across categories and global product lines. “BlackRock’s ability to originate and structure at scale is leading to premier financing relationships and sourcing opportunities for our clients. We’ve raised $68 billion in private markets over the last twelve months, and our AI Infrastructure Partnership made its first deployment this quarter. “BlackRock is in a differentiated position as both a trusted advisor and destination for global client capital. That position is powering organic growth and value for our shareholders. We’re entering our seasonally strongest fourth quarter with accelerating momentum, and a broad pipeline spanning whole portfolio, private markets, retirement, and our international platforms. Demand for capital is growing across the global economy, and BlackRock is increasingly at the center of how that capital is deployed and managed. I’m confident in the opportunities that creates for our clients and in the long-term value we can generate for our shareholders.” FINANCIAL RESULTS NET FLOW HIGHLIGHTS (1) (in millions, Q3 Q3 Q3 YTD except per share data) 2026 2025 (in billions) 2026 2026 AUM $ 15,488,263 $ 13,463,625 Long-term net flows: $ 175 $ 510 % change 15 % Average AUM $ 15,460,140 $ 12,960,773 By region: % change 19 % Americas $ 125 $ 400 Total net flows $ 205,466 $ 204,642 EMEA 31 100 APAC 19 10 GAAP basis: Revenue $ 7,752 $ 6,509 By client type: % change 19 % Operating income $ 2,328 $ 1,955 Retail: $ 23 $ 57 % change 19 % US 17 45 Operating margin 30.0 % 30.0 % International 6 12 Net income (1) $ 1,659 $ 1,323 % change 25 % ETFs: $ 135 $ 444 Diluted EPS $ 10.57 $ 8.43 Active 22 61 % change 25 % Core equity 3 120 Weighted-average Digital assets 8 6 diluted shares 164.5 165.2 Fixed income 61 163 % change - % Precision & other 41 94 As Adjusted (2) : Institutional: $ 17 $ 8 Operating income $ 3,330 $ 2,621 Active 44 112 % change 27 % Index (27 ) (104 ) Operating margin 47.8 % 44.6 % Net income $ 2,621 $ 1,907 Cash management net flows $ 31 $ 17 % change 37 % Diluted EPS $ 15.93 $ 11.55 Total net flows $ 205 $ 527 % change 38 % _________________________ _________________________ (1) Net income represents net income attributable to BlackRock, Inc. reference.summary: BlackRock, Inc. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm primarily provides its services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors including corporate, public, union, and industry pension plans, insurance companies, third-party mutual funds, endowments, public institutions, governments, foundations, charities, sovereign wealth funds, corporations, official institutions, and banks. It also provides global risk management and advisory services. The firm manages separate client-focused equity, fixed income, and balanced portfolios. It also launches and manages open-end and closed-end mutual funds, offshore funds, unit trusts, and alternative investment vehicles including structured funds.
